notes: The schematic image was not visible; connections are inferred from the text and the standard 2N7000 bidirectional level-shifter: gate to 3.3V (VCC), source to the 3.3V Arduino signal pin, drain to the NeoPixel DIN with a 10k pull-up to 5V.
The manual does not state the data pin; pin 6 is assumed.
The layout uses a single NeoPixel instead of the ring, as the manual says; the ring would connect the same way (5V, GND, DIN). The NeoPixel is powered from the board 5V pin (USB-supplied) and GND.
Breadboard hole positions are assumed. Wires from the board header go to the breadboard (the board is not plugged into it).
The antenna, SIM, LiPo battery connector, and micro USB cable are modelled with board ports ANT, SIM, BATT+/BATT-, USB; the code and serial monitor are not modelled.
